import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check for correlation among top features
    top_features = feats.ids[:10]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]].T)
    
    # Identify near-duplicates (correlation >= 0.6)
    near_duplicates = set()
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                near_duplicates.add(top_features[i])
                near_duplicates.add(top_features[j])
    
    # Remove near-duplicates and keep only unique features
    unique_features = [fid for fid in top_features if fid not in near_duplicates]
    
    # If we have no mechanism, return empty drivers
    if len(unique_features) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Fit logistic regression to check for stratum-specific effects
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in unique_features]]
    y = feats.y
    
    # Try to fit model within strata
    stratum_effects = []
    for stratum in set(feats.stratum):
        mask = np.array(feats.stratum) == stratum
        if np.sum(mask) > 1:
            X_stratum = X[mask]
            y_stratum = y[mask]
            
            # Standardize
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            X_stratum_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_stratum)
            
            # Fit logistic regression
            lr = LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=True, max_iter=1000)
            lr.fit(X_stratum_scaled, y_stratum)
            
            # Get coefficients
            coef = lr.coef_[0]
            stratum_effects.append(coef)
    
    # If all strata show similar effects, we can consider this a true mechanism
    if len(stratum_effects) > 1:
        # Check variance across strata
        effect_matrix = np.array(stratum_effects)
        variances = np.var(effect_matrix, axis=0)
        if np.all(variances < 0.1):  # Low variance indicates consistency
            # Return top features as drivers
            drivers = tuple(unique_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
            return Design(
                drivers=drivers,
                columns=unique_features,
                products=(),
                loadings={fid: 1.0 for fid in unique_features}
            )
    
    # Otherwise, no mechanism found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
